descriptions.zh: <warning>该接口只能取消状态为”**等待执行**“的任务，已运行或者已结束的任务不能取消。</warning>
descriptions.en: <warning>This API can only cancel tasks with the status "**Waiting to Run**." Tasks that are already running or have ended cannot be canceled.</warning>
